description: This file defines the ConfigInstallerInterface interface for classes responsible for installing configuration in Drupal, including methods for default, optional, and collection configuration installation, as well as storage management and dependency checks.

methods.name: installDefaultConfig
methods.description: Installs the default configuration for a specified extension type and name, with an optional mode parameter.

methods.name: installOptionalConfig
methods.description: Installs optional configuration if it does not already exist, is a configuration entity, and dependencies are met.

methods.name: installCollectionDefaultConfig
methods.description: Installs all default configuration within a specified collection, useful for responding to site events like language creation.

methods.name: setSourceStorage
methods.description: Sets the configuration storage that provides default configuration.

methods.name: getSourceStorage
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration storage providing default configuration, or null if not set.

methods.name: setSyncing
methods.description: Sets the status of the synchronization flag.

methods.name: isSyncing
methods.description: Returns whether the synchronization flag is set.

methods.name: checkConfigurationToInstall
methods.description: Checks if the configuration for an extension can be installed, throwing exceptions if dependencies are unmet or config pre-exists.
